title: Blob reference (claim check)
description: A value stored in object storage instead of inline. Any object in input, output or run data that has the $blob key is a reference. The key is $blob, not $ref, so data never looks like a JSON Reference. Objects are written once (If-None-Match: *); on step.succeeded each $blob must be under the attempt blob_prefix or already known in the same run, otherwise the result is rejected as fatal invalid_blob_ref.

keep.description: Exempt from blob GC after the run ends.
